ios.desc:
Telepromptr is your best solution for a simple, professional Teleprompter app.

No account needed... Just type, import or paste your text and start in seconds.

Over 11 years on the App Store, and featured on the App Store "Make a Film with iPad" promotion.

Now, re-imagined with a modern design and a suite of new features. 

Telepromptr is designed to be lightweight, reliable and versatile. Perfect for video production, presenting, speaking, meetings, music performances and more!

Key features
• Simple & intuitive design
• Portrait & Landscape support on all devices
• Record Video
• Mirroring (no upgrade required)
• Remote Control with a keyboard or any compatible controller
• Text: Adjust the colours, size, font and line spacing
• Easy Markdown formatting for bold/italic
• Import Word, PDF, plain text and Markdown documents
• Eyeline Mode aligns the text beside your camera for better eye contact
• Save and re-use Style Presets
• See your words per minute and time remaining
• Output to connected displays via AirPlay or HDMI
• Add a countdown timer before scrolling starts


The optional Pro upgrade is available as a one-time in-app purchase forever, or as a subscription. If you chose to subscribe (optional), you can cancel anytime within the app, or from your Apple ID settings.
